title: Very Light Italian Yeast Panettone
description: A lighter and fluffier version of the traditional panettone, featuring shio-koji and cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, perfect for a solo dinner

ingredients.name: plant-based milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

ingredients.name: shio-koji
ingredients.notes: see notes on using shio-koji in bread recipes

ingredients.name: egg replacement
ingredients.notes: such as flaxseed or mashed banana

instructions: Combine rye flour, plant-based milk, shio-koji, yeast, and granulated sugar in a mixing bowl and stir until a shaggy dough forms
Add unsalted plant-based butter, egg replacement, vanilla extract, and salt to the dough and mix until a sticky ball forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a greased ttukbaegi earthenware pot and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and bake the panettone for 35 minutes
Let the panettone cool in the pot for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely
If desired, top the panettone with chopped candied citrus peel
